series.label: Killed since 2 March 2026 (MoPH cumulative)
series.license: WHO/OCHA: not stated; Wikipedia part CC BY-SA 4.0
series.notes: Cumulative deaths from Israeli attacks since the 2 Mar 2026 escalation, as reported by Lebanon's Ministry of Public Health (MoPH). Irregular days (reporting gaps), not a daily series. point_src codes: W = WHO EMRO Lebanon Emergency Sitrep (MoPH-PHEOC box), O = OCHA Lebanon Flash Update (MoPH), P = news-quoted MoPH figure compiled in Wikipedia's timeline. Priority W > O > P when two sources give the same date. Sources: https://www.emro.who.int/lebanon/information-resources/lebanon-emergency-situation-reports.html ; https://reliefweb.int/country/lbn?search=%22Lebanon%3A+Flash+Update%22 ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Timeline_of_the_2026_Lebanon_war. MoPH counts include combatants and civilians and are revised as bodies are identified (WHO sitrep 18: 8 April figures provisional; 60 deaths awaiting DNA, 30 missing).

series.label: Killed since 8 October 2023 (MoPH cumulative, 2023-24 war)
series.notes: MoPH cumulative deaths since 8 Oct 2023 (combatants and civilians), as quoted in OCHA Lebanon Flash Updates #1-49 (Nov 2023 to 5 Dec 2024). Ends at 4,047 on 5 Dec 2024, the figure after the 27 Nov 2024 ceasefire. Gaps: 8 Oct-14 Nov 2023 and 25 Sep-3 Oct 2024 (no exact figure found). Earlier 2024 updates give 'casualties' as killed + wounded; the injured series is that total minus deaths. CORRECTION 2026-10-02 (V2 verification): 2024-10-04 was 1,699 killed / 9,781 injured (inconsistent: injured above MoPH 4 Oct); replaced with MoPH press-conference figures 1,974 killed / 9,384 injured (Minister Abiad, 4 Oct 2024, via Anadolu; L'Orient Today gives a 2,011 total at midnight 3-4 Oct, not used). The 2,083 / 9,869 point is now dated 2024-10-08 (MoPH totals reported 8 Oct 2024, Middle East Eye); it was dated 2024-10-07. Not re-read against the OCHA Flash Updates.

series.label: Injured since 8 October 2023 (MoPH cumulative, 2023-24 war)
series.notes: MoPH wounded since 8 Oct 2023. For 18 Apr-20 Sep 2024 the value is derived: OCHA's 'casualties' total minus its 'deaths' figure. The 20 Sep 2024 value (3,112) includes the 17-18 Sep device explosions. Same gaps as war2324_killed_cum. CORRECTION 2026-10-02 (V2 verification): 2024-10-04 was 1,699 killed / 9,781 injured (inconsistent: injured above MoPH 4 Oct); replaced with MoPH press-conference figures 1,974 killed / 9,384 injured (Minister Abiad, 4 Oct 2024, via Anadolu; L'Orient Today gives a 2,011 total at midnight 3-4 Oct, not used). The 2,083 / 9,869 point is now dated 2024-10-08 (MoPH totals reported 8 Oct 2024, Middle East Eye); it was dated 2024-10-07. Not re-read against the OCHA Flash Updates.

series.label: People displaced since 8 October 2023 (IOM DTM via OCHA)
series.notes: Headline IOM Displacement Tracking Matrix (DTM) figure as quoted in an OCHA Lebanon Flash Update. The DTM dataset itself (HDX lbn-iom-dtm-from-api) is NOT redistributed here because IOM's HDX terms restrict redistribution and derivative works; only the figure published by OCHA is reproduced. Licence flag for the owner: see README. Before 23 Sep 2024 the figure is 'displaced from south Lebanon' (about 99% of it); from 25 Sep 2024 it is 'displaced since 8 Oct 2023' nationwide (cumulative, includes people who later returned). Peak 899,725 on 25 Nov 2024. The 1 Nov 2024 date is approximate (Flash Update #41 published 4 Nov).

series.label: People still displaced outside their cadaster of origin, 2024-25 (IOM DTM via OCHA)
series.notes: Headline IOM Displacement Tracking Matrix (DTM) figure as quoted in an OCHA Lebanon Flash Update. The DTM dataset itself (HDX lbn-iom-dtm-from-api) is NOT redistributed here because IOM's HDX terms restrict redistribution and derivative works; only the figure published by OCHA is reproduced. Licence flag for the owner: see README. Series starts after the 27 Nov 2024 ceasefire (Mobility Snapshot rounds). The 31 May 2025 point (82,632) is IOM DTM Round 87 as printed in the Lebanon Response Plan 2026 population package (HDX, CC BY). 12 Feb 2025 (115,234) is a rise reported by IOM for that round.

series.label: People displaced in 2024 reported back in their cadaster of origin (IOM DTM via OCHA)
series.notes: Headline IOM Displacement Tracking Matrix (DTM) figure as quoted in an OCHA Lebanon Flash Update. The DTM dataset itself (HDX lbn-iom-dtm-from-api) is NOT redistributed here because IOM's HDX terms restrict redistribution and derivative works; only the figure published by OCHA is reproduced. Licence flag for the owner: see README. Excluded: 12 Dec 2024 value 902,717 printed in Flash Update #50. With the 178,817 still displaced it implies 1.08 million people, above the 984,514 total that IDMC and the 31 Dec 2024 round give, so it is probably a typo for 802,717 (hypothesis, not verified).

series.label: New internal displacements from conflict and violence (IDMC annual)
series.notes: IDMC Global Internal Displacement Database, Lebanon, annual new displacements from conflict and violence (disaster displacement is a separate IDMC file). Years with no data are omitted; zeros are IDMC zeros. 2026 not yet published (GIDD update of 4 Jun 2026 covers 2025).

series.label: Total internally displaced by conflict and violence at year end (IDMC)
series.notes: IDMC GIDD stock of IDPs at 31 Dec. 984,514 at end-2024.

series.label: Total displaced, government count (MoSA self-registration / DRM), 2026 war
series.notes: Government (Ministry of Social Affairs and Disaster Risk Management unit) running total of displaced people, from WHO Lebanon sitreps #4-11 and OCHA Flash Updates #10-36 ('>1,049K'). From OCHA Flash Update #37 the 'total displaced' box switches to the IOM DTM count (844,243 = IOM Round 104, 17 Jun), see idp_stock_dtm_2026. The figure stayed at 1,049,328 (OCHA: '>1,049K') from 17 Mar to 18 Jun in every report; the 18 Jun point only marks the end of that plateau and is not a new count. OCHA/UNHCR text says over 1.2 million displaced when people outside formal registration are included (Flash Update #10, 17); that is an estimate, not a series.

series.label: People displaced nationwide, current stock (IOM DTM Mobility Snapshot), 2026 war
series.notes: Headline IOM Displacement Tracking Matrix (DTM) figure as quoted in an OCHA Lebanon Flash Update. The DTM dataset itself (HDX lbn-iom-dtm-from-api) is NOT redistributed here because IOM's HDX terms restrict redistribution and derivative works; only the figure published by OCHA is reproduced. Licence flag for the owner: see README. Primary source: IOM DTM Mobility Snapshot rounds 104-117 on ReliefWeb ('As of' date = IOM data date; OCHA quotes each a day later). Round 105 (24 Jun, 704,445) is dated from IOM's round 106 text ('29 per cent decrease compared to 24 June'); its own page has no text. The 29 Sep point (329,686; Round 118) is reported (not independently verified): read from a web-search extract of IOM's page, not fetched. OCHA Flash Update #40 key figures print 449,784 but its text and IOM say 499,784. The government (MoSA) count in idp_total_registered_2026 is a different, higher count.

series.label: People reported returned to areas of origin (IOM DTM Mobility Snapshot), 2026 war
series.notes: Headline IOM Displacement Tracking Matrix (DTM) figure as quoted in an OCHA Lebanon Flash Update. The DTM dataset itself (HDX lbn-iom-dtm-from-api) is NOT redistributed here because IOM's HDX terms restrict redistribution and derivative works; only the figure published by OCHA is reproduced. Licence flag for the owner: see README. Rounds 104-117 as above; 29 Sep (877,203) reported (not independently verified) from a search extract. The 19 Aug value (817,458) is lower than 13 Aug (863,172) as printed in Flash Update #51; no explanation given there, kept as reported. 523,000 on 24 Jun is 'more than 523,000' (OCHA #38, round 105; IOM's own page has no text).

series.label: Displaced people hosted in collective shelters (DRM), 2026 war
series.notes: Disaster Risk Management unit dashboard figure as printed in OCHA Lebanon Flash Updates #1-52 and WHO sitreps 4-12. Early OCHA figures (#1-10, #28-36) are rounded to the nearest thousand in the key-figures box. Peak 141,733 on 16 Apr 2026. The three September points are IOM DTM rounds 116-118 (DRM dashboard data), the 29 Sep one reported (not independently verified) from a search extract.

series.label: Open collective shelters (DRM), 2026 war
series.notes: Count of collective shelters (many are schools) from OCHA Lebanon Flash Updates. Peak 690 on 16 Apr 2026.

series.label: Public schools used as collective shelters, 2026 war
series.notes: Ministry of Education (MEHE) figures quoted by OCHA: 287 (8 Mar), 328 (9 Mar), 331 public schools (22 Jun), 179 (13 Jul). The government had designated 700 public schools as possible shelters on 5 Mar (Flash Update #1).

series.label: Schools of all types used as collective shelters, 2026 war
series.notes: Public, private and technical (TVET) schools. 22 Jun 2026: 446 = 331 public + 66 private + 49 TVET out of 3,341 schools. 356 schools were awaiting a decommissioning assessment on 6 Jul.

series.label: Health workers killed in verified attacks since 2 March 2026 (WHO SSA)
series.notes: WHO Surveillance System for Attacks on Health Care as printed in WHO Lebanon sitreps 12-30. Includes first responders. Figures are revised after verification: 53 killed on 24 Mar fell to 42 on 27 Mar. OCHA Flash Update #19 gives 100 deaths and 233 injuries from 147 attacks as of 20 Apr, consistent with the WHO sitrep. Insecurity Insight counts 149 health workers killed in 2026 on a wider definition.

series.label: Health workers injured in verified attacks since 2 March 2026 (WHO SSA)
series.notes: Same source and caveats as who_ssa_hw_killed_cum_2026.

series.label: Attacks on health care verified since 2 March 2026 (WHO SSA)
series.notes: Count printed in sitreps 10-16 (28 on 15-17 Mar, then 61, 64, 79, 88, 92) and OCHA Flash Update #19 (147 on 20 Apr). Later sitreps print only injuries and deaths.

series.label: Hospitals damaged since 2 March 2026
series.notes: MoPH/PHEOC count in WHO sitreps 19-30 (partial or major physical damage). Lebanon has about 173 hospitals (Lebanon Response Plan 2026 package).

series.label: UNIFIL incidents of denial of freedom of movement
series.notes: Monthly count in the UN Secretary-General's 1701 reports, as published on HDX (Peace and Security Pillar). The HDX file covers Mar 2023 to Feb 2024 only; later periods are not in the open file.

series.label: Air violations of Lebanese airspace recorded by UNIFIL, per Secretary-General reporting period
series.license: UN document; reuse with attribution (no licence stated)
series.notes: Totals for each 4-month 1701 reporting period; t = the month the period ends. Periods: 21 Oct 2023-20 Feb 2024 (S/2024/222: 1,816, 5,859 h); 21 Feb-20 Jun 2024 (S/2024/548: 1,551, 5,682 h); 21 Jun-20 Oct 2024 (S/2024/817: 1,892 to 22 Sep plus 1,293 from 23 Sep = 3,185); 21 Oct 2024-20 Feb 2025 (S/2025/153: 1,295 to 26 Nov plus 1,331 = 2,626); 21 Feb-20 Jun 2025 (S/2025/460: 2,318); 21 Jun-20 Oct 2025 (S/2025/738: 3,027); 21 Oct 2025-20 Feb 2026 (S/2026/160: 3,091); 21 Feb-20 Jun 2026 (S/2026/566: 9,993; 12,677 hours). Reporting periods are not equal in air activity timing; compare with care.

series.label: Overflight time of air violations recorded by UNIFIL, per reporting period
series.license: UN document; reuse with attribution (no licence stated)
series.notes: Total overflight hours per Secretary-General reporting period (S/2024/817: 7,251 h to 22 Sep + 7,450 h from 23 Sep = 14,701). 2025-02 report gives no hours. Same caveats as unifil_air_violations_period.

series.label: Cumulative people displaced since 2 March 2026, first two weeks (IDMC Internal Displacement Updates)
series.notes: IDMC IDU national-level reports for the 2026 escalation, each from the agency in point_src with its qualifier (approximately, at least, nearly). Mixed sources: not one consistent count. 9 Mar 700,000 is UNICEF 'nearly' (upper bound). Excludes the 10 Mar 117,228 sheltered figure and the UNHCR 31,000 (2 Mar, 'more than'), which would duplicate 2-3 Mar.
